title: Shiguang Coffee | Monthly operations report, October 2026

sources.name: Fictional monthly totals (sample)
sources.query: Three monthly summary CSV files in data/; every figure is fictional

revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.definition: Fictional revenue summed by month; reconciles with revenue by channel and by region

orders.label: Orders
orders.definition: Fictional paid orders, counted by payment month

visitors.label: Visits
visitors.definition: Fictional store and app visits summed by month; the denominator of order conversion

conversion.label: Order conversion
conversion.definition: Orders ÷ visits, recomputed from the summed numerator and denominator

average_order_value.label: Average order value
average_order_value.definition: Revenue ÷ orders, recomputed from the summed numerator and denominator

active_members.label: Monthly active members
active_members.definition: Distinct members active during each month; a monthly snapshot that is never summed across months

revenue.label: This month
revenue.definition: Fictional revenue attributed to each channel; channels do not overlap and add up to the monthly total

previous_revenue.label: Last month
previous_revenue.definition: Fictional revenue of the same channel in the previous calendar month, for the month-over-month comparison

revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.definition: Fictional revenue assigned to each region; regions do not overlap and add up to the monthly total
